constraints.name: Tolerance specification
constraints.description: Mounting hole diameters: 3.2 ± 0.1mm (must accommodate M3 bolts). Wall thickness: 2.0 ± 0.2mm minimum (any thinner becomes unreliable). Corner radius: 1.5 ± 0.5mm (tolerances loose for aesthetic feature).

constraints.name: Minimum dimensions
constraints.description: Minimum wall thickness: 1.5mm (below this, parts break in use). Minimum hole diameter: 3mm (printer nozzle limits). Minimum feature size: 0.4mm (printer resolution). Minimum width: 50mm (must accommodate four holes with 10mm inset).

constraints.name: Design rules
constraints.description: All fillets must be >= 1mm for reliable 3D printing. Walls must be at least 2mm thick everywhere to avoid flex/breakage. Mounting holes must always be exactly in the four corners. Pattern spacing cannot be less than 5mm between features.

constraints.name: Material-specific rules
constraints.description: No draft angles needed (not molded). PLA shrinks slightly (0.3-0.5%) after cooling. Minimum wall thickness 1.5mm for reliability. Sharp corners/edges fail first under load, so all corners rounded. Overhangs less than 45° print reliably without support.

constraints.name: Parameter dependencies
constraints.description: The height of mounting bosses depends on base width (15% ratio). Hole spacing depends on the post connector standard. Reinforcement ribs only extend to 80% of the width (leave margin at edges).
